thesis: AMPL has strong idiosyncratic momentum (stacked uptrend, +41% over 63 days, revenue growth accelerating to 24.9% YoY, cash 140.5M vs debt 9.3M), but the 22.0 target depends on breaking 18.85, a level rejected on heavy volume on Nov 5, and volume (ratio 0.94) gives no breakout confirmation. Reward/risk to that first resistance is only about 0.7, and the regime is risk-off (confidence 0.8) with XLK down 10.2% over 21 days and ^TNX at 5.141, a headwind for a rich, GAAP-loss-making growth name. Nominal R/R from 17.5 is 2.31, but with even the bull putting target odds at 0.30 the edge is too thin to open a position; upgrade only on a close above 18.85 on volume above 1.8M. Sentiment card unavailable this run.
invalidation: A daily close below 15.62 (Nov 6 swing low), or a failed push at 18.85 that closes back under the 17.0 SMA20 on rising volume, invalidates the bullish setup.
key_risks: Hard supply at 18.85 from the Nov 5 post-earnings reversal (high 18.85, close 16.10 on heavy volume)
Risk-off regime with tech lagging (XLK ret_21 -10.2%, QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX 1y percentile 0.877)
Rising long yields (^TNX 5.141, 1y percentile 0.914) pressure a rich valuation (forward P/E 105.97, P/S 5.71)
High volatility (ATR 0.8514, 4.8% of price) can carry a de-rating from the 17.0 SMA20 to the 15.6 stop quickly
GAAP losses persist (Q3 net income -24,524,000, margin -25%), and the IBD 'profits doubled' headline conflicts with SEC data
No scheduled catalyst before next earnings (date not in packet)
